translations.en: "All paths connect,
but not all lead to the answer."
Was it some kind of charm?
Words were carved into an impressive stone monument.
"There are other paths.
Other paths seldom lead to the answer."
Though the monument was splendid, it appeared
not to have been tended for many years.
The switch was already activated.
You saw it streak through the air toward Area 4.
An old book lay on the ground.
Its cover bore letters you had never seen before.
That seemed to be the only noteworthy thing about it.
Some kind of pattern marked the wall.
On closer inspection, it was only a stain.
Strangely, parts of it looked like human faces.
Something like bloodstains marked the floor.
There were no bodies nearby, but the blood looked fresh.
Considering who had made them, perhaps you should be careful.
Words were written in blood on the wall.
"Challenge yourself before challenging your enemy!"
There was a sign on the wall.
"Experimental Teleportation Circle.
Under development. Do not open."
It was a very old sign.
Had development already finished?
There was a treasure chest. Will you examine it?
The treasure chest suddenly opened!
Powerful magic poured out from inside.
You were sent flying.
You decided to ignore the chest and leave.
Leave slowly
Leave quickly
You hurried away.
Water was flowing from a crack in a small rock.
Perhaps it was groundwater.
It flowed clear and unstagnant, its reflected light soothing your heart.
Clear water flowed across the floor.
There were probably creatures that depended on this water to survive.
It looked extremely cold,
but it might be delicious to drink.
A sign hung on the door.
"Junk Storage."
There was a broken pickaxe.
Could someone really have built this labyrinth with it?
There were marks on the floor.
There seemed to be more than ten of them.
Why had someone made these marks?
There were about three marks.
Only the third mark was carved unusually deep.
There was only one mark.
It was extremely large.
You sensed something terribly desperate in it.
Words were carved into the floor.
"I found sooo much treasure!
I'm so happy, I just had to scribble something!"
Was it a woman's handwriting?
Even so, you sensed something like hatred in it.
There were torn sleeping bags and the charred remains of torches.
They were relatively new and seemed to have been used recently.
Nothing else of interest was in sight.
An open wooden crate lay on its side.
Along its side were marks that seemed to have been made
by someone kicking it repeatedly and violently.
Unsurprisingly, the box was empty.
There were many footprints.
They pointed every which way.
Yet none of the footprints led south.
Yet none of the footprints led west.
The footprints pointed in a jumble of directions.
There seemed to be fewer leading north.
There was a switch.
Powerful magic shot from the switch
and burst toward you.
There was a sign.
"Beware of the dog. Keep away."
Was it some kind of warning?
Words were carved on the door.
"I commend your courage in proceeding.
I condemn your decision to try."
